defect: The new loose-comparison branch of isUrlValid rejects any URL without a dot, so valid hosts such as https://myowndomain:8000 or localhost are reported invalid.
reason: The fix removes exactly the !url.contains(".") condition that this change added and adds a test for a dotless host.

defect: The fix continues the work-in-progress auto-type syntax regexes (VKEY without suffix, delay and repetition checks) whose results are not yet used.
reason: The validation results only feed empty TODO branches and debug output, so the regex change has no observable effect; the fix is continued feature development.

defect: The fix changes onOffIcon to build a single-state icon per toggle so on/off icons are recoloured on theme change.
reason: This change only renamed resources()->onOffIcon to icons()->onOffIcon; the cached pre-rendered on/off icon behaviour existed before it.

defect: The fix handles a null current group when editing an entry from search results.
reason: The currentGroup()->name() dereference predates this change, and search was only added later (6b6c1099), so this change only added a metadata argument.

defect: The new call to MHD_is_feature_supported(MHD_FEATURE_IPv6) does not exist in the libmicrohttpd shipped on the supported Ubuntu Trusty build, breaking compilation.
reason: The Travis fix removes exactly this added call to make the build pass; seeing it requires knowing the library version on the build platform.

defect: The fix recolours icons on a temporary transparent image because SourceAtop compositing directly on the target canvas produces a black box in QTableView.
reason: The previous code also drew onto the target painter and filled with SourceAtop there, so compositing on a non-transparent canvas predates this change.

defect: The fix only wraps over-long lines.
reason: Pure style change, no behaviour repaired.

defect: The new isEmpty() reads m_compUi->enterPasswordEdit, which is only created when the edit page is set up, so calling it while the widget is not on the edit page dereferences an uninitialised UI pointer and crashes.
reason: The fix guards exactly this added function with visiblePage() == Page::Edit; the crash path depends on the caller in the key-editing dialog.

defect: The fix stops deduplicating attachments when computing history size and counts each history item's attachments fully.
reason: Deduplication against already-found attachments existed before this change; the fix is a change of the size-accounting policy rather than a repair of a line this change broke.

defect: The fix removes the ignoredAttachments parameter from attachmentsSize.
reason: This change was a pure code-style rewrite that preserved the semantics exactly; the dedup policy came from earlier commits.

defect: The fix rewrites and re-baselines the history-size tests after changing the size computation.
reason: Test-only changes following a policy change; no defect in the added test lines is repaired.

defect: The new HTTP settings page is added with its remove-keys and remove-permissions signals left unconnected (commented out) and saving the settings does not start or stop the service.
reason: The fix wires the page through a settings-page interface that connects these signals and starts/stops the service on save; the commented-out connects are in the diff.

defect: The new test uses QDateTime::setMSecsSinceEpoch, which does not exist in Qt 4.6, the minimum Qt version the build accepts, so the tests fail to compile there.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this call with setTime_t; the incompatibility needs the CMake minimum Qt version (4.6.0) to see.

defect: The added currentDatabase->releaseData() calls dereference a null shared pointer when interactive mode is exited without an open database.
reason: The fix moves the release after the loop under an if (currentDatabase) check; the same function already guards currentDatabase for the prompt.

defect: The fix distinguishes found-but-denied entries from no entries, stores denials on dialog reject, and moves httpAuth into EntryParameters.
reason: This change only bundled parameters into structs without altering the find/confirm logic; the repaired behaviours existed before it.

defect: The added setsockopt call passes an int* where Windows expects const char* and lacks the Winsock2 include, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The fix, which names 3a92e4 as the regression, adds the include and the char* cast to exactly this call.

defect: The three new clones in testClone are never deleted, leaking memory in the test.
reason: The fix only wraps test-local pointers in QScopedPointer; a leak inside a unit test is a test-hygiene change, not a product defect.

defect: The new {CLEARFIELD} sequence presses Ctrl and Shift as separate SendKey events around Home/End, which the fix replaces with a modifier mask passed to SendKey.
reason: The fix rewrites the whole X11 key-sending path (XSync, Lock handling, modifier release); from the code I cannot tell whether the reported auto-type failure came from these added lines or from pre-existing modifier handling.

defect: The change declares SendKey(KeySym, bool isKeyDown) to split press and release, which the fix replaces with SendKey(KeySym, modifiers) and new modifier helpers.
reason: The header only declares the split API; whether the later X11 auto-type failure stems from the split press/release or from older modifier code cannot be determined from the diff and repository.

defect: Correcting the directory key makes handleDirectoryChanged effective, so it now emits fileChanged/fileCreated/fileRemoved in addition to handleFileChanged, which the fix aggregates.
reason: The fix message attributes the duplicates to QFileSystemWatcher emitting several signals, which predates this change, so it is unclear how much this change contributed.

defect: The new recent-databases list on the welcome screen is filled only once in the constructor, so it goes stale as databases are opened and closed (and only reacts to double-click).
reason: The fix (closes #386) moves the filling into refreshLastDatabases() for later refresh and uses itemActivated; seeing the staleness needs the widget's lifetime in MainWindow.

defect: The change declares removeIdentity(OpenSSHKey&) const while the definition in SSHAgent.cpp stays non-const (and assigns m_error), so the SSH agent build no longer compiles.
reason: The 'Fixed regression' commit reverts exactly this const qualifier; the mismatch is only visible next to the .cpp.

defect: The fix makes the toolbar separator depend on the tab count and the current stacked widget because the tab bar's visibility is wrong when started hidden in the tray.
reason: This change only folded the m_showToolbarSeparator check into the expression; reliance on tab bar visibility predates it.

defect: m_countDefaultAttributes already counts the separator in the copy-attribute menu, so the loop starting at m_countDefaultAttributes + 1 never deletes the first custom attribute action and the entries accumulate.
reason: The fix drops exactly this +1 that this change carried over; knowing the separator is counted needs the .ui menu definition.

defect: The fix switches copy actions to resolveMultiplePlaceholders so fields with embedded placeholders like {TITLE}.{USERNAME} are resolved.
reason: With this change such fields are copied raw, exactly as before it; the fix extends placeholder support rather than repairing a regression.

defect: The fix switches the entry view to resolveMultiplePlaceholders so embedded placeholders are displayed resolved.
reason: Such fields display raw text, as they did before this change; the fix adds multi-placeholder resolution.

defect: The fix replaces m_instance->dataPath with dataPath in wordlistPath.
reason: wordlistPath is a member called via filePath(), so m_instance is valid and the two are equivalent; the Windows crash came from the static QString DefaultSeparator in PassphraseGenerator.

defect: The fix changes DefaultWordCount to constexpr and the static QString defaults to const char*.
reason: The crash was due to the static QString members added by 6723f42; the static const int added here is harmless and only restyled.

defect: disconnect(dbWidget, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) removes every connection of each open DatabaseWidget, breaking the rest of the application's signal wiring.
reason: The fix restricts the disconnect to this receiver; the overly broad disconnect is visible in the added line.

defect: HTML-escaping the group name and entry title in the edit-entry headline shows entities such as & literally because the headline is shown as plain text.
reason: The fix removes exactly these added toHtmlEscaped calls; knowing the headline label is not rich text needs EditWidget.

defect: Using setShortcut(actionDatabaseNew, QKeySequence::New, Ctrl+Shift+N) keeps the platform's standard New key (Ctrl+N), so New database does not get Ctrl+Shift+N and clashes with New entry.
reason: The fix assigns Ctrl+Shift+N directly and gives QKeySequence::New to the entry action; the fallback-only semantics are in setShortcut's implementation.

defect: The fix also locks focus when the menus are opened from the menubar and keeps entry actions enabled while the menubar or search field has focus.
reason: Gating entry actions on currentEntryHasFocus() predates this change; the fix covers remaining cases (#3246, #3034) this change did not touch.

defect: The change reworks how the KDBX version and default KDF are initialised now that kdf() is never null, which the fix replaces with formatVersion-based setup and per-version KDF lists.
reason: The fix (#10558) is a broad rewrite of the encryption settings logic, and the repository does not show which part of the misbehaviour came from these lines rather than older code.

defect: The new file includes zxcvbn/zxcvbn.h, which only resolves relative to the source tree and breaks out-of-tree builds.
reason: The fix (#3658) changes exactly this added include to zxcvbn.h; the problem depends on the CMake include paths.

defect: The new updateGroupActions() slot takes no group and only updates the delete action, so the new New/Edit group context actions stay enabled with no current group (e.g. in search) and dereference a null group.
reason: The fix changes the slot to updateGroupActions(Group*) and disables new/edit without a group; the faulty body is in DatabaseWidget.cpp.

defect: The fix reworks key-component activation (password unchecked by default, setting text unconditionally) for opening from the command line.
reason: The isNull to isEmpty change has no meaningful effect because the field is cleared anyway; issue #2877 comes from the checkbox activation logic.

defect: The fix compares canonical file paths and always calls performUnlockDatabase so a key file alone can unlock.
reason: The filePath comparison predates this change, and the password-only guard became wrong only once a keyfile argument was added later.

defect: The new connect targets a nonexistent slot updateAttachments(), so attachment changes never refresh the SSH agent list and Qt prints a connect error.
reason: The fix replaces it with updateSSHAgentAttachments(), the slot this same change added.

defect: Converting m_inAutoType to a QMutex makes resetInAutoType and performAutoTypeFromGlobal unlock it unconditionally, so when both select-dialog slots run the mutex is unlocked twice or while not locked.
reason: The fix (#1561, double slot execution) moves the lock and unlock into executeAutoTypeActions and drops resetInAutoType; the double signal comes from AutoTypeSelectDialog.

defect: The fix renames the KEEPASSXC_SNAP_BUILD checks to KEEPASSXC_DIST_SNAP after a later CMake rename.
reason: KEEPASSXC_SNAP_BUILD was defined in CMakeLists and config-keepassx.h at this commit; the macro was renamed later (6d433fec).
